MVP_z: sign of aligned log odds ratio times two-sided normal quantile from reported p; odds ratios rounded; no usable SE
frequency: source effect-allele frequency oriented to prototype counted allele
reference: same previously verified ordered 1000 Genomes dosage LD matrices; cross-chromosomal correlations set to zero
limitations: Post hoc, weights and candidates previously inspected against target data, target overlap and variant interpretation uncertain. Approximate marginal-Z covariance and common effective sample; not individual-level score prediction or independent replication.
